title: Educational Campaigns for Product Labels: Evidence from On-Shelf Nutritional Labeling
authors: Bryan K. Bollinger; Eli B. Liebman; David G. Hammond; Erin P. Hobin; Jocelyn E. Sacco
eligible_reason: Single adoption date and no concurrent untreated unit. The Guiding Stars educational campaign ran nationally from January 9 to February 5, 2015 for every store and household at once. The 'two-way fixed effects' design uses the previous year (Sept 2013-Apr 2014) as a nonconcurrent control: treatment = campaign-week dummy x treatment-year dummy, with week-of-year x store FE and a year dummy. There is only one treatment cohort and no untreated unit in any treated period, so no staggered-adoption comparison exists. Specifications also include time-varying controls (quadratic in store-week transactions, star-level price indices).
design_notes: Equation 1 (store-week, Table 2): log(y_jwy) = a(D_w x z_y) + b(P_w x z_y) + z_y + store x week-of-year FE + quadratic in n_jwy + star-level price indices; weighted by transactions; clustered by store. Household-store-week version adds household FE, quantity-weighted, clustered by household. Equation 2 (UPC-store-week, Table 3): store x year FE, store x week-of-year FE, store-UPC FE, price and assortment controls, two-way clustering (UPC, store). Equation 3 (household-week-category, Table 4): household-category FE, category x week-of-year FE, category x year FE. Equation 4: fixed-effects multivariate logit. Figure 5: week-of-year x treatment-year 'event study' (single cohort). Robustness in Web Appendix (full year as control, servings weights, levels, three-period aggregation per Bertrand-Duflo-Mullainathan).
estimators_reported: TWFE with previous year as nonconcurrent control (single cohort)

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Table 2, HH-level data row, Three-Star Share column (During x Treatment)
ineligible_specs.treatment_var: During-campaign week dummy x treatment-year dummy
ineligible_specs.fe: household FE, store x week-of-year FE, year dummy
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date, no concurrent untreated unit; time-varying controls

data_availability_statement: None found. Transaction and loyalty-card data from a national Canadian grocery retailer (acknowledged for 'data support'); Guiding Stars ratings from the Guiding Stars Licensing Company; authors' own exit surveys.
screener_notes: Cites de Chaisemartin and D'Haultfoeuille (2019) only to motivate the two-way FE approach; the design is a pre-post comparison against the prior year. The Nova Scotia chain analysis (Web Appendix OA.E) is also a single-date campaign. Not a candidate for re-estimation.
